question.text: A Category III AIF can be structured as any of the following EXCEPT:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 4.1 / Ch 5.2.1, Cat III AIFs can be a Trust, LLP, Company, or Body Corporate — NOT an HUF. **The Trap:** HUF is not a permissible AIF vehicle. **Cross-Exam Context:** Consistent across all AIF categories. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Set up as Trust for maximum tax pass-through; LLP for flexibility; Company for perpetual succession.
